scenes.title: Daydream secretary song
scenes.summary: Opening musical daydream sequence in which Magüi imagines singing a romantic secretary song for courier Álex in the office.

scenes.title: Faith and Photos
scenes.summary: Paquita pitches Mariona on the phone as the new Carmen Machi, explains that every newcomer needs faith and photos, and despairs over Mariona's terrified smile.

scenes.title: Opening theme song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence song following Paquita through the streets of Madrid.

scenes.title: Filling In a Profile Form
scenes.summary: After updating client David on a lost commercial, Paquita and Magüi sit down with Mariona to fill out her agency profile form covering age, languages, eye colour, and height.

scenes.title: Expert in Fencing
scenes.summary: Continuing the profile form, Paquita and Magüi ask Mariona about her weight and special skills, applaud her South American accent, and list her as an expert in fencing.

scenes.title: No to Nepotism
scenes.summary: Courier Álex asks on his way out if Paquita has watched his cousin's showreel; Paquita tells him she loved it, then admits to the camera she refuses to watch cousins' tapes.

scenes.title: A Little Extra Money
scenes.summary: Actress Lidia San José visits the agency to demonstrate a rotating skincare device and explains how she likes earning extra money between television and theatre jobs.

scenes.title: It Also Removes Hair
scenes.summary: Lidia reveals that the skincare device also removes hair and diagnoses Paquita's dry elbows, prompting Mariona to pitch a dramatic solo short film she wrote.

scenes.title: We Are Professionals
scenes.summary: Lidia mentions a new feature film produced by Paquita's ex-husband Paco; refusing to ask Paco for favours because he is still in love with her, Paquita calls the casting office instead.

scenes.title: She Hung Up on Me
scenes.summary: Paquita rings the casting office to pitch Mariona as the perfect leading lady, only to get hung up on mid-sentence and admit to Mariona that nobody wants new faces.

scenes.title: People Eat with Their Eyes
scenes.summary: Inspired by sales advice to show the product in person like cheese samples at a supermarket, Paquita buys two skincare devices and marches Mariona straight to the casting office.

scenes.title: Without an Appointment
scenes.summary: Outside the casting building, Paquita hands her card to a famous young actress, gets turned away at reception for lacking an appointment, lectures Mariona on Spanish cinema, and sneaks inside.

scenes.title: Starting from Scratch
scenes.summary: Paquita bursts into the casting office claiming she was just passing through the neighbourhood, praises Mariona's comic timing, and hears why television networks reject unknown actresses.

scenes.title: Another Day They Will See You
scenes.summary: Exhausted, the casting director confesses a craving for hot dogs with ketchup and mustard and refuses to see Mariona, leaving Paquita to promise Mariona outside that they will see her another day.

scenes.title: Musical transition across Madrid
scenes.summary: Brief musical interlude as Paquita crosses town to visit her ex-husband Paco's production office.

scenes.title: A Woman Has Her Secrets
scenes.summary: Surprising her ex-husband Paco at his office, Paquita drops her bag, reveals the paperback romance she is reading, and trades playful literary banter before stepping inside.

scenes.title: A New Girl at the Office
scenes.summary: With Magüi keeping watch outside for Paco's wife, Paquita swallows her pride and asks Paco to grant her new actress an audition for one of his films.
scenes.location: Paco's production office and street outside

scenes.title: My Own Way
scenes.summary: At her long-awaited audition, Mariona steps onto the floor mark, explains that she prepared her own bold character proposal without a script, and performs a fiery improvised phone call.

scenes.title: Closing credits song
scenes.summary: Closing musical sequence over the final credits of the episode.
